title: Run a program with a specific environment variable removed
summary: Execute a command while temporarily removing a specific environment variable. This helps test if a program behaves differently without a certain setting.

steps.explain: Use the --unset flag followed by the variable name to remove it from the environment for this specific command.

placeholders.name: VARIABLE
placeholders.description: The name of the environment variable to remove

placeholders.name: PROGRAM
placeholders.description: The command or program to run
